arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,tempfile,shutil,hashlib,base64,gzip,sys
from pathlib import Path
target='martaxi-boss/Project-leader-codex'
sha='902079f6559880eaab8e6948b7c125c5b486de1c'
branch='fix/rea-codex-worker-env-20261030'
tmp=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='rea-plcodex-safety-negative-fix-',dir='/tmp'))
tmp.chmod(0o700)
try:
 src=tmp/'source'
 subprocess.run(['git','clone','--quiet','--depth','4','--branch',branch,'https://github.com/'+target+'.git',str(src)],capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=75)
 current=subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(src),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True,capture_output=True,check=True).stdout.strip()
 assert current==sha,'BRANCH_HEAD_CHANGED'
 core=src/'codex/agent_policy.py'
 test=src/'codex/tests/test_agent_policy.py'
 old='''def _safety(request: str) -> list[str]:
    text = request.casefold()
    flags = []
'''
 new='''def _safety(request: str) -> list[str]:
    text = request.casefold()
    # An explicit prohibition is not a request to perform a sensitive action.
    # Only suppress the negated "deploy" mention; any positive or production
    # mention elsewhere must still invoke the Project Leader authorization gate.
    text = re.sub(
        r"\\b(?:do\\s+not|don't|never|n[aã]o|sem)\\s+(?:(?:fazer|realizar|executar)\\s+)?deploy\\b",
        " ", text,
    )
    flags = []
'''
 content=core.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
 assert content.count(old)==1,'CODEX_SAFETY_SIGNATURE_CHANGED'
 core.write_text(content.replace(old,new),encoding='utf-8')
 marker='''    def test_planned_material_boundaries_carry_unchanged_human_authority(self):
'''
 insert='''    def test_explicit_non_deploy_prohibitions_do_not_block_safe_worker_tasks(self):
        safe_orders = (
            "Do not deploy this isolated smoke-test artifact.",
            "Never deploy these local test files.",
            "Não fazer deploy das alterações de teste.",
            "Sem executar deploy dos ficheiros locais.",
        )
        for prompt in safe_orders:
            with self.subTest(prompt=prompt):
                p = plan(request([item("test", "codex/tests/smoke.txt", prompt)]))
                self.assertEqual(p["status"], "planned")
                self.assertNotIn("material_boundary_requires_project_leader_controls",
                                 p["warnings"])

    def test_material_actions_still_require_authority_even_with_negation(self):
        material_orders = (
            "Deploy this new version now.",
            "Do not deploy yet, then deploy after verification.",
            "Do not deploy to production.",
            "Não fazer deploy primeiro; depois fazer deploy.",
            "Never deploy; release the production version.",
        )
        for prompt in material_orders:
            with self.subTest(prompt=prompt):
                p = plan(request([item("test", "src/core", prompt)]))
                self.assertIn("material_boundary_requires_project_leader_controls",
                              p["warnings"])

'''
 txt=test.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
 assert txt.count(marker)==1,'CODEX_TEST_INSERT_POINT_CHANGED'
 test.write_text(txt.replace(marker,insert+marker),encoding='utf-8')
 proc=subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(src),'diff','--check'],text=True,capture_output=True)
 assert proc.returncode==0,'DIFF_CHECK_FAIL'
 proc=subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(src),'diff','--name-only'],text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
 expected={'codex/agent_policy.py','codex/tests/test_agent_policy.py'}
 assert set(proc.stdout.splitlines())==expected,'UNEXPECTED_FILES'
 env={'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1','PYTHONPATH':str(src)}
 import os
 env={**os.environ,**env}
 for label,directory in [('CODEX','codex/tests'),('CONTROL','tests')]:
  p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','unittest','discover','-s',directory,'-p','test_*.py','-q'],
     cwd=src,text=True,capture_output=True,env=env,timeout=150)
  stdout=p.stdout+'\n'+p.stderr
  summary=[l.strip() for l in stdout.splitlines() if l.strip().startswith('Ran ') or l.strip()=='OK' or l.strip().startswith('FAILED ')]
  print(label+'_RESULT',p.returncode,';'.join(summary[-4:]),flush=True)
  if p.returncode:
   print(label+'_FAIL_TAIL',stdout[-1200:].replace('\n',' | '),flush=True)
   raise RuntimeError(label+'_TESTS_FAILED')
 for name in sorted(expected):
  raw=(src/name).read_bytes()
  print('FILE_META',name,len(raw),hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),flush=True)
  print('FILE_GZIP_B64_START',name,flush=True)
  print(base64.b64encode(gzip.compress(raw,mtime=0)).decode('ascii'),flush=True)
  print('FILE_GZIP_B64_END',name,flush=True)
 print('NEGATION_CORRECTION_REA_TESTED_PASS',flush=True)
finally:
 shutil.rmtree(tmp)
 print('TEMP_CLONE_CLEANED',flush=True)
PY
